ITEM 1 | Pale yellow-green avocado-like wedge with smooth, slightly glossy flesh and a darker green skin edge, cut into a crescent piece about 9 cm long and 2.5 cm wide, roughly 1.5 cm thick, standing upright on its cut edge beside the greens; firm, holds shape, no browning or char | 75
ITEM 2 | Dark green-black leafy greens with crinkled, slightly wilted texture and visible red-purple stems, cooked and moist with a faint sheen, forming a loose mound about 9 cm across and 2.5 cm tall, piled on the right side of the bowl; no breading or char | 85
ITEM 3 | Thick deep red-brown stem pieces, glossy and firm, about 4 cm long and 1 cm wide, scattered among the greens and lying next to the avocado; looks like cooked chard stalk, moist surface, holds shape | 25
ITEM 4 | Pale green-yellow avocado skin piece, thin and slightly curved, about 6 cm long and 1 cm wide, lying flat under the avocado wedge at the lower left of the bowl; smooth, matte, no browning | 10
